finding.statement: The general lab guide implies per-epoch inference costs are subtracted when known; the real-Jev guide specifies subtraction only when every consultation cost is known. src/lab/run.ts matches the all-known rule, omitting known costs from all epochs if any cost is null.
finding.impact: The inference-cost gate remains unknown, so this cannot qualify the run; descriptive net returns may nevertheless be overstated for partial-cost runs.
finding.action: Decide desired accounting semantics, align both guides, and add a mixed-known/unknown cost regression before changing code.
